description: Indicator Summary Data: Change in Snow Depth and Snow Water Content in BC (1950-2014) is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Climate Action Secretariat. This tabular dataset is the result of an analysis supporting the indicator 'Change in Snow Depth and Snow Water Content in BC (1950-2014)' published in Indicators of Climate Change for British Columbia (2015-16 Update) and on Environmental Reporting BC. The analysis used snow monitoring data from the B.C. Data Catalogue. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Climate Action Secretariat. Its tags are climate change, environmental reporting, indicator, snow, snow depth. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2018-07-12 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
